subject: The one feature 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: A user confessed this buried setting changed everything. It's hidden in plain sight. You probably missed it.
body_paragraphs: Got a confession from a user last week. She almost deleted the app. Said the summaries were good, but she was still missing things. Then she found one setting. Buried. Never mentioned in onboarding. She said it felt like the app started reading her mind.

Here's the thing: the AI is smart, but it doesn't know what's important to YOU. It guesses based on most users. This one user was in a technical planning meeting. The AI highlighted dates and deliverables. She needed the architecture debate. The 'why' behind a decision. She was ready to quit.

She found the 'Priority Keywords' list. It's in Settings > AI Preferences. You tell the app 5-10 words that are gold in your world. 'Risk', 'blocker', 'assumption', 'client-request'—whatever matters. Now, the AI doesn't just summarize. It hunts. It highlights every instance of YOUR keywords. It structures the summary around what you care about.

Open the app. Go to Settings right now. Find 'AI Preferences' and add your Priority Keywords. It takes 60 seconds. Then run your last meeting through the summary again. Watch it transform. P.S. The user who found this? She now says she looks like a psychic in meetings, anticipating every critical turn.
